reviewer: Codex author/source review, not independent human expert annotation

novelty_limit: Fresh tasks on seen units. Entire source units were previously available to retrieval; line non-overlap does not establish model non-exposure. Generic null/metadata/refusal/indexing skills necessarily overlap.

source_caveats: Spreadsheet null-marker compatibility table is a course statement, not a current all-library guarantee. Literal markers are not SQL/Python runtime semantics.
Python plain-interpreter completion is reported as the course workflow, not guaranteed configuration.
The source patient examples are educational; no CSVs or student/medical production files are used.
No evidence uses video timestamps; Markdown lines and pinned URLs are authoritative.
